fields.desc: One three-to-five-word benefit sentence that the tool or service enables. Active voice, one line; e.g. Explain your product or Turn ideas into videos. Keep the central idea clear; at most 64 characters.
Translation only: preserve the promise to engage an audience. Translate naturally without adding a different product claim; at most 64 characters.

Optional audience illustration: a natural, smiling adult headshot with a simple neutral background. Different people may illustrate audience diversity; this is not an endorsement or customer claim. Keep the face centered with no text. Omit if unsuitable.
